usages.explain: Modify the noun that follows and express various meanings of that noun, such as characteristics, states, types, quantities, etc.

examples.content: 我が家には3人の娘がいます。
examples.transcription: わがやには3にんのむすめがいます。
examples.mean: We have three daughters at home.

examples.content: 彼女に青色の花をあげる。
examples.transcription: かのじょにあおいろのはなをあげる。

title: N1 の N2 => N2 has the property or quantity N1 (Property)
